summary_brief: 2026年5月13日，AI Agent生态系统在"多智能体生产化"（May 6-12主线）基础上进入"记忆与评估精细化+结构化执行"第三深化阶段。今日出现一个明确的**历史坐标级新节点**：Anthropic所有主流SDK（Python/TS/Go/Java）**首次跨语言同步发布**BetaManagedAgents API和Stream Events v3，标志SDK生态从"并行演进"升级为"协调共振"，是112份日报以来的最深度跨语言标准化事件。延续趋势方面：(1) LangGraph 1.2.0 durable error-handler跨主机崩溃恢复将"可靠性工程"从讨论推进至生产实现；(2) 多智能体协作从角色系统（May 12）演进至subagent角色分工（explore/implement/verify）+ Goose Hooks结构化可编程工作流；(3) 评估体系从二元判分（May 12 partial-credit）跃升至mem0 LongMemEval 94.8基准量化+时序推理评测，记忆系统从"能力扩展"升级为"可量化评估+生产可靠性"新维度。RuFlo内存层关键修复（向量索引维度不匹配导致memory_search返回0）则将"可靠性工程"锚定至记忆持久化这个高风险边界。整体处于5月6-12高位活跃周期的自然深化，非新转折点，但记忆与评估的精细化代表生态进入"基础设施标准化→生产可靠性→精细化度量"三阶段收敛的第三阶段。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 工作流精细化：从对话到结构化执行
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: subagent 角色系统（explore/implement/verify）与 Goose Hooks 系统共同推动 Agent 从简单对话向结构化、可编程工作流演进，这是构建复杂 AI 自动化应用的基础设施。

engineering_signals.title: SDK 生态加速标准化：多 SDK 同步升级机制成熟
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 所有主流 SDK（Python/TS/Go/Java）同步发布 BetaManagedAgents API 和 Stream Events v3，Claude Code Action 同时被多个仓库依赖，表明 SDK 生态进入协同演进阶段，降低了跨语言集成的碎片化风险。

engineering_signals.title: 评估体系精细化：从二元判分到梯度量化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 新增 partial-credit 评分列替代 binary pass/fail，配合 mem0 LongMemEval 基准提升和 Temporal Reasoning 能力，表明 AI Agent 评估正从粗糙的通过/失败向细粒度能力度量演进，为迭代优化提供更精准的信号。

engineering_signals.title: 生产级可靠性：LangGraph durable error-handler 与记忆系统修复
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: LangGraph 1.2.0 的跨主机崩溃恢复能力和 RuFlo 向量索引维度不匹配修复（导致 memory_search 返回 0）表明生产级 AI 应用正聚焦于弹性恢复和数据完整性，这是大规模部署的必要条件。

engineering_signals.title: 安全加固成为自托管方案核心诉求
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Dify 1.14.1 修复 SECRET_KEY 默认漏洞、IDOR 权限问题和 CVE-2026-42208，OpenDevin 修复登出后 token 失效和路径冲突检测，多个开源项目同步加强安全基线，反映自托管 AI 平台的安全标准正在快速提升。

engineering_signals.title: Tool-target-aware 上下文加载成为 Agent 标配
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 将 AGENTS.md 加载从 cwd-aware 扩展到 tool-target-aware，灵感来自 Gemini CLI JIT context 模式，解决了 agent 在不同目录操作时遗漏本地指令的痛点，这将成为跨目录复杂项目的标准模式。

engineering_signals.title: 代码执行运行时多元化：QuickJS 加入生态
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: DeepAgents 基于 QuickJS 的实验性 CodeInterpreterMiddleware 提供了轻量级代码执行选择，与传统的进程隔离方案形成互补，拓展了 AI Agent 的能力边界和部署灵活性。

release_signals.title: LangGraph 1.2.0 重大架构升级
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 durable error-handler 跨主机崩溃恢复能力，set_node_defaults() API，以及 delta channel 强制快照机制，显著提升了生产级工作流的可靠性

release_signals.title: Stream Events v3 API 统一升级
release_signals.why_it_matters: LangChain 1.3.0 和 DeepAgents 0.6.0 同时支持 stream_events/astream_events v3 版本，统一了事件流接口标准

release_signals.title: Dify 1.14.1 安全加固
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复 SECRET_KEY 默认漏洞、内指标接口暴露、IDOR 权限问题，并升级 LiteLLM 修复 CVE-2026-42208，显著提升自托管安全性

release_signals.title: Vercel CLI 54.0.0 Breaking Change
release_signals.why_it_matters: vercel logs 命令强制要求 --follow 标志才能流式传输，新增环境变量跨服务引用支持，属于重大 CLI 变更

release_signals.title: DeepAgents CodeInterpreterMiddleware
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增基于 QuickJS 的实验性代码执行运行时，支持程序化工具调用，拓展了 AI Agent 的能力边界

release_signals.title: Anthropic SDK BetaManagedAgents API
release_signals.why_it_matters: 所有主流 Anthropic SDK (Python/TS/Go/Java) 同时新增 BetaManagedAgentsSearchResultBlock 类型和 Cache Diagnostics Beta 支持

release_signals.title: Zed AI Agent 编辑可靠性提升
release_signals.why_it_matters: 改进编辑工具在文件变更时的健壮性，减少 token 使用，并支持 Git Graph 远程分支可视化

release_signals.title: Goose v1.34.0 Hooks 系统
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 Hooks 支持实现可自定义 Agent 行为，Agents CRUD 操作，以及 Linux Vulkan 本地推理支持

release_signals.title: Phoenix 15.8.0 思考控制
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 Anthropic 和 Google 模型的思考控制功能，增强 Playground 可观测性

release_signals.title: Claude Code Agent Tool Matching 改进
release_signals.why_it_matters: subagent_type 匹配支持大小写和分隔符不敏感，提升了 Agent 间协作的灵活性

release_signals.title: RuFlo 内存层关键修复
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复向量索引维度不匹配导致 memory_search 返回 0 的严重问题，修复内存路径硬编码导致持久化失败

releases.summary:
## 14 critical fixes since `3.7.0-alpha.27`

Cumulative batch release closing out an issue-triage cycle. The prior bumps (`.28`→`.32`) shipped their fix-sets to npm immediately but had no GitHub Release writeup; this is the consolidated changelog.

### Memory layer (8 fixes)

| Issue | Fix |
|---|---|
| **#1947** | `vector_indexes` schema dim 768→384 (default model `Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` is 384-dim — schema mismatch silently made every `memory_search` return 0). |
| **#1942** | Bridge search index 768 vs imported 384-dim — same root cause as #1947, observed via the Bridge import path. |
| **#1952** | Windows: `memory store` ok, search returns 0 — same root cause as #1947, observed on a Windows install. |
| **#1945** | CLI `memory store` reported success but didn't persist on non-default memory paths — `memory-bridge.ts::getDbPath()` hard-coded `<cwd>/.swarm/memory.db` and ignored `CLAUDE_FLOW_MEMORY_PATH` / `claude-flow.config.json#memory.persistPath`. |
| **#1946** | `ruflo doctor` reported DB "Not initialized" on a valid DB at `data/memory/memory.db` — same hard-coded-path family as #1945. |
| **#1941** | `memory_search` returned 0 for non-default namespaces — every store path now `INSERT OR IGNORE`s a per-namespace `vector_indexes` row before the entry insert. |
| **#1940** | `memory_bridge_status` reported `totalEntries: 0` on DBs with hundreds of rows — used `listEntries({}).entries.length` (page-size capped at 20) instead of `.total`. |
| **#1939** | Win32 `memory_import_claude({allProjects:false})` returned 0 — slug logic only replaced forward slashes, never drive-colon / backslash / whitespace. |
| **#1947 RC #2** | `embeddings index -a build` required `-c` (the HNSW index is global; the flag was always informational). Now optional. |

### Hooks layer (2 fixes)

| Issue | Fix |
|---|---|
| **#1944** | `pre-bash` printed `TypeError: (hookInput.command || prompt).toLowerCase is not a function` on **every** Bash tool call — handler fell back to the `toolInput` *object* instead of `toolInput.command`. |
| **#1943** | Every Bash / Edit / Session hook fired `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` on a global-install layout — paths were anchored at `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` only. Now probes project-local first, falls back to `$HOME`. |

### UI / statusline (2 fixes)

| Issue | Fix |
|---|---|
| **#1953** | `hooks_pretrain` reported `patternsExtracted: 0` on Markdown-heavy repos — used a separate `codeFilesScanned` budget, sorts readdir code-likely dirs first, widened scan window 30→80 lines, added `.tsx`/`.jsx`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`. |
| **#1951** | Statusline showed hard-coded `RuFlo V3.5` regardless of installed version — now probes `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/ruflo/package.json` first. |

### Verification (1 unblock)

| Issue | Fix |
|---|---|
| **#1949** | Federation plugin install 403 on `cookies@0.9.1` (the latest published version, but blocked by registry security policy). Added `scripts/verify-federation-plugin.sh` that pins `cookies@0.9.0` at the verification harness root — both Check 2 (exports) and Check 3 (breaker wire-up) pass. Workaround until upstream `pipenet` → `koa` → `cookies` ships a non-blocked release. |

### CI regression guards baked in

- `scripts/audit-vector-dim.mjs` — fails the build if any `vector_indexes` row's dim ≠ 384 (#1947 guard).
- `scripts/audit-hook-handler-prompt.mjs` — fails the build if any handler / template falls back to a bare `toolInput` (object) instead of `toolInput.command` (string) (#1944 guard).

Both wired into the existing `witness-verify` and `hook-command-audit` jobs in `.github/workflows/v3-ci.yml`.

### Install

```bash
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest --version    # 3.7.0-alpha.33
npx ruflo@latest --version               # 3.7.0-alpha.33
npx claude-flow@latest --version         # 3.7.0-alpha.33
```

All three packages on `alpha`, `latest`, and `v3alpha` tags (where applicable).

### Still open (not in this release)

- **#1948** — Win32 random temp files in repo root (`0)`, `toastr.error(...`). Vague repro; needs reporter to narrow which tool path creates them.
- **#1937** — Feature request: per-file exclusion for `memory_import_claude`. Design work, not a bug.

---

PRs in this release: #1956 · #1957 · #1959 · #1960 · #1961 · #1962 · #1963 · #1964 · #1965

key_changes: 修复向量索引维度不匹配：schema 从 768 维改为 384 维，修复了 `memory_search` 始终返回 0 的问题
修复 Windows 平台兼容性：内存存储路径处理和 Claude 导入功能的多个问题
修复非默认路径配置失效：`getDbPath()` 硬编码路径问题，支持 `CLAUDE_FLOW_MEMORY_PATH` 和配置文件中的路径设置
修复命名空间隔离问题：非默认 namespace 的 `memory_search` 现在能正确返回结果
修复 CLI 状态报告错误：`memory_bridge_status` 使用正确的 `.total` 字段替代受分页限制的 `.entries.length`
ai_summary.summary_cn: v3.7.0-alpha.33 是一个累积补丁版本，包含 14 个关键修复，主要针对内存层（8 个）和 Hooks 层（2 个）的严重问题。最关键的是向量索引维度不匹配导致的搜索功能完全失效，以及多个 Windows 平台兼容性和路径配置问题。"]

- Terminal: Improved 256 color ANSI rendering. ([#54565](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/54565); thanks [feitreim](https://github.com/feitreim))

([#54863](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/54863); thanks [OmChillure](https://github.com/OmChillure))

---

*Learn about the [Zed Guild](https://zed.dev/community/zed-guild).*

- Fixed a bug where placeholder text in the agent panel's message editor wouldn't properly wrap. ([#55125](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/55125))

- Fixed a rare panic when invoking Helix motions on an editor that had not yet been laid out. ([#55816](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/55816))

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Improved Agent tool `subagent_type` matching to accept case- and separator-insensitive values (e.g. `"Code Reviewer"` resolves to `code-reviewer`)
- Updated agent color palette
- Fixed `/goal` silently hanging when `disableAllHooks` or `allowManagedHooksOnly` is set — now shows a clear message instead of an indicator that never resolves
- Fixed a regression in settings hot-reload where symlinked settings files caused misattributed change events and spurious `ConfigChange` hooks
- Fixed `claude --bg` failing with "connection dropped mid-request" when the background service was about to idle-exit
- Fixed background service startup failing on machines with enterprise endpoint security by allowing more time
- Fixed remote managed settings not retrying on 401 — now retries once with a force-refreshed token
- Fixed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` auto-update policy not being persisted to `known_marketplaces.json`
- Fixed `/loop` scheduling redundant wakeups to poll for background tasks that already notify on completion
- Fixed a recurring event-loop stall on Windows when a missing executable (e.g. `gh`) triggered synchronous `where.exe` re-spawns on every check
- Fixed `Read` tool calls failing validation when `offset` is passed as a whitespace-padded or `+`-prefixed string
- Fixed native terminal cursor not staying at the input caret when the terminal loses focus
- Plugins now warn when a default component folder (e.g. `commands/`) is silently ignored because `plugin.json` sets the matching key. Shown in `/doctor`, `claude plugin list`, and `/plugin`.

修复 `claude --bg` 后台服务空闲退出时的连接中断问题
修复 Windows 上缺少可执行文件导致事件循环周期性卡顿的问题
修复设置热重载中符号链接文件导致的配置变更事件误判问题
修复远程托管设置 401 错误后未正确重试的问题

releases.author: laipz8200
releases.summary:
## 🚀 What's New in v1.14.1?

v1.14.1 is a patch release focused on security hardening, workflow and knowledge-base stability, deployment cleanup, and continued UI platform migration after v1.14.0.

### 🔐 Security

- **Self-hosted `SECRET_KEY` hardening** — Docker deployments no longer rely on a public default key. When `SECRET_KEY` is left empty, the API generates and persists a runtime key through the configured storage backend, while explicitly configured keys continue to work as before. Thanks @laipz8200 in [#36049](https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/36049).

## Upgrade Guide

### Important notes

- This release includes a new database migration for configurable Explore app categories. Run database migrations as part of the upgrade.
- Docker Compose environment variables are now split into categorized files under `docker/envs/**`. If you maintain a customized `docker-compose.yaml` or `.env`, review the new layout and re-apply local customizations carefully.
- For self-hosted deployments, explicitly configured `SECRET_KEY` values continue to be respected. If `SECRET_KEY` is empty, Dify now generates and persists a runtime key automatically.

### Docker Compose Deployments

1. Back up your customized docker-compose YAML and env files.

   ```bash
   cd docker
   cp docker-compose.yaml docker-compose.yaml.$(date +%s).bak
   cp .env .env.$(date +%s).bak 2>/dev/null || true
   ```

2. Get the latest code from the release branch or tag.

   ```bash
   git fetch --tags
   git checkout 1.14.1
   ```

3. Stop the service. Please execute in the `docker` directory.

   ```bash
   docker compose down
   ```

4. Back up data.

   ```bash
   tar -cvf volumes-$(date +%s).tgz volumes
   ```

5. Review the new `docker/envs/**` env file layout and re-apply any local customizations.

6. Upgrade services.

   ```bash
   docker compose up -d
   ```

### Source Code Deployments

1. Stop the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server.

2. Get the latest code from the release tag.

   ```bash
   git fetch --tags
   git checkout 1.14.1
   ```

3. Update Python dependencies.

   ```bash
   cd api
   uv sync
   ```

4. Run the migration script.

   ```bash
   uv run flask db upgrade
   ```

5. Restart the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server.

issue_insights.summary_brief: 跨仓库分析发现 5 类高影响共性问题：SSE 流式通信在多个 Agent 框架中因事件流边界处理错误导致实时功能完全阻断（anomalyco/opencode 等），MCP 协议在本地 stdio 模式下工具调用失败或执行路径异常（opencode、claude-code），OAuth/认证循环导致长任务被反复中断（AndyMik90/Aperant、claude-code），以及会话状态在崩溃后无法恢复（claude-code、TabbyML/tabby）。另有多个 P0 级单仓问题需紧急处理，包括 agentscope-ai/agentscope 的 Formatter 层内存泄漏级联崩溃和 anthropics 生态中的 SDK 导入及二进制解析器严重缺陷。
global_highlights: SSE 流式事件边界处理缺陷影响跨 50+ 仓库：anomalyco/opencode 因单换行符拼接导致 AI_JSONParseError，claude-code 因 2026-05-12 构建引入的 disclaimer helper 导致 tools/call 从未写入 MCP stdio 服务器
OAuth/Token 认证循环导致长任务反复中断：AndyMik90/Aperant 因 token 格式不匹配和 CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR 优先级被覆盖，claude-code 因 auto-mode 权限分类器信任衰减和硬拦截误归因
会话状态持久化崩溃恢复机制失效：claude-code 将空 thinking 和空 tool_result 内容块写入 JSONL 导致旧会话永远无法恢复，TabbyML/tabby 在本地服务器模式下直接回写 git 未暂存变更

P0 单仓关键缺陷：agentscope-ai Formatter 层 deepcopy 内存泄漏 + DeepSeek API 400 拒绝级联崩溃；anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript 本地二进制解析器在 glibc 系统错误选择 musl 变体完全阻断 SDK 启动；anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python 文档示例 append_messages() 无限循环破坏 tool runner 核心模式

top_pain_points.review_reason: 两个 issue 均指向任务启动/初始化阶段的主流程阻断：Issue #2003 中 Kanban dashboard 无法启动规划导致流程直接失败；Issue #1870 中 Planning agent 在 Jira MCP 已连接的情况下仍无法调用工具，导致关键规划数据缺失。虽然各自独立触发，但根因均为主流程初始化失败，且用户体验到的是'我无法正常使用核心功能'，而非边缘异常。

source_issues.title: failed after 3 attempts. last error: error
source_issues.evidence: Kanban dashboard 场景下，每次启动任务都报 'failed after 3 attempts. last error: error'，导致规划阶段无法开始，主流程被阻断。

source_issues.title: BUG: Planning agent cannot use Jira MCP tools despite server showing 'connected successfully'
source_issues.evidence: Planning agent 在 Jira MCP 服务器已显示连接成功的情况下，仍无法调用 getAccessibleAtlassianResources、search 等工具，最终放弃并写出缺少 Jira 数据的评估文件，核心规划功能不可用。

source_issues.title: Hitting rate limits on Claude Max plan and task fails (rate_limit_event)
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告在 Claude Max 计划下，任务在 complexity_assessment 和 spec_writing 等多个 phase 中反复收到 'Agent error: Unknown message type: rate_limit_event'，最终所有 phase 在 3 次重试后全部失败。Issue 中附有多次重复尝试的完整日志，显示问题在同一任务的多个 phase 中稳定复现。

source_issues.title: [agents] investigate clientside tracing for external tools
source_issues.evidence: Issue explicitly states: 'When commit 71ceeb3fa6 ripped the v1 /chat route, we lost backend TOOL spans for tools that the AI SDK / browser executes.' External tools raise NotImplementedError server-side; only synthetic backfill spans exist. This is a direct observability failure for the product's core tracing feature.

source_issues.title: [agents] [ui] cap session storage in the UI, make session storage off by default
source_issues.evidence: Issue explicitly states 'this is to remove an infinite memory growth' and requests capping session storage and making it off by default. Direct resource exhaustion risk if left unaddressed.

source_issues.title: Fix OpenRouter Sonnet behavioral evals returning empty trajectories and 0/32 results
source_issues.evidence: Full-suite baseline produced CSVs at 0/32; per-run conversation.jsonl missing any assistant message; generation time 3-7s but run/eval time 0.0; same symptom as prior direct-Anthropic regression in session 2f00

source_issues.title: Windows: Browser not launching for authentication

source_issues.title: [BUG] OpenAI API key works locally but fails inside CrewAI with 401 invalid_api_key

source_issues.title: [URGENT] Langfuse trace isolation issue affecting users who installed 1.14.1
source_issues.evidence: Two users reported Dify spans appeared in wrong Langfuse projects. Sensitive trace data may have been exposed across tenants. Root cause: Langfuse v3 SDK uses global OpenTelemetry TracerProvider causing cross-tenant span leakage.

source_issues.title: Password reset always returns 400 invalid_or_expired_token in 1.14.x — _TokenData TypedDict strips the phase field

The phase gate always fails, making password reset completely non-functional.

source_issues.title: opencode run prefers stale PWD over subprocess cwd

source_issues.title: Bundled CLI silently drops inbound TRACEPARENT on 2nd+ query() call when ~/.claude/ has state from a prior run
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible 100% of the time in a long-running Python process. call-1 spans nest correctly under TRACEPARENT; call-2+ produce orphan root spans with no parent trace_id. The root cause is ~~/.claude.json state (firstStartTime marker) that causes the CLI to skip OTel init on subsequent starts. Wiping ~/.claude/ between calls unblocks the bug. The workaround (unique HOME per call) has ~20KB cost per call.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Running `claude sessions list` via Bash tool triggers recursive process fork bomb, consuming entire usage quota

source_issues.title: Resuming old sessions returns API Error: 500 status code (no body) — caused by empty thinking and tool_result blocks persisted to JSONL

source_issues.title: Telegram channel poller silently dies after claude mcp list or /mcp health check from another session

source_issues.title: Severe memory leak in Docker container when MCP tool returns very large responses (~3 million characters)

source_issues.title: Agent cache does not record or replay custom tool calls

signals.topic: External tool spans missing in agent (PXI) traces — observability gap

signals.review_reason: A core observability feature (trace spans for tool calls) is broken for all external tool invocations in the agents/PXI workflow. The current backfill workaround introduces wrong trace IDs and synthetic timestamps, fundamentally degrading the tracing data quality that users rely on. While only 1 issue, the scope of affected tools is large (bash, ask_user, set_time_range, read_prompt, edit_prompt, clone_prompt_instance, set_spans_filter) and this directly impacts Phoenix's primary value proposition.

signals.topic: Session storage unbounded growth — memory leak risk in PXI UI

signals.review_reason: Unbounded memory growth in a UI component is a well-defined reliability issue that, if triggered by heavy usage, will cause browser tab crashes or OOM kills — a direct service disruption for the agent workflow. The issue owner explicitly labels it as 'infinite memory growth', meeting the threshold for a user-facing reliability pain point.

signals.topic: Frontend sends 'undefined' string as integer query parameter causing API 400 validation error when fetching agents by graph ID
signals.summary: The frontend sends version='undefined' (string) in the /api/library/agents/by-graph/{graph_id} GET request, causing FastAPI validation to reject it with a 400 int_parsing error. Users cannot fetch published agents by graph ID from the library.
aliases: Library agent fetch broken due to frontend sending undefined
signals.review_reason: Frontend bug confirmed by labeled issue ('bug', 'platform/frontend') and Sentry error evidence. The frontend JavaScript passes the literal string 'undefined' instead of an integer for the version query parameter, causing a 400 API validation error that blocks users from fetching library agents by graph ID. This is a specific feature failure, not a system-wide outage.

source_issues.title: Validation failed for GET /api/library/agents/by-graph/{graph_id}: version='undefined'

signals.topic: Smart Decision Maker block fails with 400 Anthropic error when output structures require duplicate tool names

aliases: Smart decision maker block broken with multiple output formats
signals.review_reason: Labeled 'bug' with Sentry evidence showing Anthropic API 400 error due to duplicate tool names. Maintainer acknowledges the issue: AutoGPT does not restrict tool name uniqueness but Anthropic requires it. This blocks users from using the Smart Decision Maker block in configurations that require multiple structured output formats — a key feature use case.

Blocks users from using the Smart Decision Maker block with multiple output structures.

signals.topic: Tabby running as local server directly writes/reverts user unstaged git changes on disk
signals.summary: When tabby runs as a local server (not as a VS Code extension daemon), it performs direct WriteFile operations to source files, causing unstaged git modifications to be randomly reverted/dismissed. Users report complete loss of unsaved work with no warning.
aliases: git changes reverted while tabby running
signals.review_reason: 虽然 count=1 未达高频阈值，但 review_reason 提供强用户影响证据：tabby 直接对用户源文件执行 WriteFile 操作（Process Monitor 证实），导致未暂存的 git 修改被静默覆盖/丢弃，用户被迫逐文件从 Local History 恢复工作。这属于主流程阻断 + 数据丢失，而非低频边缘问题。标记为 P1 而非 P0 仅因单仓单例数据不足，置信度降至 0.7。

source_issues.title: When tabby is running, unstaged git changes are randomly reverted/dismissed
source_issues.evidence: User reports that after using tabby autocomplete, all unstaged modifications for files that exist on the indexed branch get dismissed. Windows Process Monitor confirms WriteFile operations from tabby.exe to source files, followed by file content changes. User had to restore files one by one via VS Code Local History. No git commands were executed — tabby is directly modifying files on disk.

signals.topic: Formatter层内存泄漏与content=null导致API拒绝级联崩溃
signals.summary: Formatter层(TruncatedFormatterBase/DeepSeekChatFormatter/OpenAIChatFormatter)存在多个关联缺陷: deepcopy(msgs)对每次API调用深拷贝所有消息导致内存无限增长(Bug A); content字段在无text内容时设为null导致DeepSeek API返回400拒绝(Bug B); convert_tool_result_to_string在工具输出为None时抛出TypeError(Bug C)。这些缺陷组合导致长对话Python进程OOM崩溃,以及会话崩溃重放后进入无限crash-loop(api拒绝→崩溃→保存空turn→重放→再次拒绝)。
signals.review_reason: 主流程运行时阻断问题。Bug A导致长对话Python进程OOM崩溃（memory bomb，每次API调用deepcopy所有消息且永不释放）；Bug B导致DeepSeek API直接返回400 Bad Request；Bug C导致工具执行TypeError崩溃。三者组合造成长对话会话彻底不可用，且存在崩溃重放无限循环。证据具体: 进程从200MB增长至3GB+，OOM可复现，与#1426关联形成crash-loop。用户影响明确: 主流程失败/阻断，且有明确成本损失风险(OOM)。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Formatter memory leak and content:null API rejection cascade
source_issues.evidence: Bug A: deepcopy(msgs) on every API call doubles memory on every call; with 200+ messages (tool outputs 100KB+), process grows from ~200MB to 3GB+ and OOM. Bug B: content=null causes DeepSeek API 400 'messages[N] content should be a string or a list'. Combined with #1426 (empty assistant turns saved on crash), creates infinite crash loop: crash→save empty turn→reload→API rejects null content→crash again. Bug C: convert_tool_result_to_string crashes on None output (TypeError), causing agent retry cascade.

signals.topic: Qwen3.5-35b-A3B与structured_model在thinking模式下tool_choice参数冲突导致BadRequestError阻断structured output
signals.summary: 使用qwen3.5-35b-a3b模型并传入structured_model参数时,AgentScope自动设置tool_choice为required或object,而Qwen thinking模式不支持该参数设置,导致openai.BadRequestError: 'tool_choice parameter does not support being set to required or object in thinking mode'。用户无法在Qwen thinking模型上使用structured output功能,阻断ReActAgent的结构化输出工作流。
signals.review_reason: 工作流阻断问题。structured_model是ReActAgent的核心功能,用户无法在qwen3.5-35b-a3b thinking模式下使用结构化输出,导致关键功能不可用。虽然count=1,但有11条评论活跃讨论,说明是已知问题且影响特定模型配置路径。P1而非P2: 影响的是核心structured output功能,非边缘改进项。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: `qwen3.5-35b-a3b` with a `structured_model` raise `openai.BadRequestError`
source_issues.evidence: When model=qwen3.5-35b-a3b and structured_model parameter is passed to ReActAgent, AgentScope sets tool_choice to required/object internally, but Qwen thinking mode does not support this parameter. Error: openai.BadRequestError: '<400> InvalidParameter: The tool_choice parameter does not support being set to required or object in thinking mode'. 11 comments indicate community discussion and active issue. Structured output is blocked for affected model+mode combination.

signals.topic: ReActAgent在模型返回纯thinking块(无text无tool_use)时提前退出循环导致空回复
signals.summary: ReActAgent的主循环退出条件(react_agent.py line 514)仅检查has_content_blocks('tool_use'),未检查text内容块。当使用支持extended thinking的模型(Claude 3.5/4, Qwen thinking)时,LLM可能只返回thinking块而不返回text或tool_use,此时has_content_blocks('tool_use')为False,循环错误地break并返回包含纯thinking内容的msg_reasoning——用户看不到任何可见文本,等于返回空回复。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断问题。ReActAgent核心循环错误地将纯thinking块响应视为有效终点并返回,导致用户收到空回复。这直接损害了agent与用户的主交互流程,是明确的体验下降。虽然count=1,但影响的是ReActAgent主循环的核心逻辑,在支持thinking的模型上是系统性缺陷。P1: 主流程受影响,但非高频(需特定模型+特定LLM输出模式触发)。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: ReActAgent exits loop prematurely when LLM returns only thinking blocks (no text, no tool_use)
source_issues.evidence: ReActAgent main loop exit condition only checks absence of tool_use blocks, not presence of text blocks. When LLM returns only thinking blocks (no text, no tool_use), agent incorrectly breaks and returns a message with no user-visible text content. This is a main-loop logic bug that directly produces empty/blank responses to users. Affects any model with thinking/extended_thinking support (qwen3.6-flash, Claude 3.5/4, etc.).

signals.topic: OpenAIChatModel.__call__缺少openai SDK原生返回参数导致ChatResponse不完整影响下游功能

signals.topic: SSE event stream closes immediately after server.connected, blocking all real-time updates and AI streaming responses
signals.summary: In OpenCode v1.14.43+, the SSE /event endpoint closes the stream ~1ms after sending server.connected. The root cause is that the eventResponse() function in the Effect HTTP API backend binds the PubSub subscription to the request scope; when the handler returns, the scope is disposed and the subscription is cancelled, terminating the stream prematurely. This makes all AI streaming responses (message.part.delta), message completion notifications (message.completed), permission requests (permission.asked), and question requests (question.asked) completely unreachable — a complete loss of the primary real-time communication channel.
aliases: Effect HTTP API backend SSE stream disposal
signals.review_reason: P0: Critical — the only mechanism for real-time updates (AI streaming, permissions, completions) is completely non-functional across an entire version range (v1.14.43+). Full loss of core real-time communication channel. Regression confirmed between Hono and Effect backends.

source_issues.title: [BUG] SSE Event Stream Closes Immediately After Connection (Effect HTTP API Backend)
source_issues.evidence: Critical bug: SSE stream closes ~1ms after server.connected. No AI streaming (message.part.delta), no message.completed, no permission.asked, no question.asked. Affects v1.14.43-v1.14.48. Regression from Hono backend.

signals.topic: MCP execute fails on local MCP servers with 'contextFn is not a function', completely blocking local MCP tool usage
signals.summary: OpenCode's MCP client successfully discovers tools from local MCP servers (type: 'local', command array), but any execute call fails with 'contextFn is not a function' and 'Tool ID not found'. The tool registry resolves the tool ID incorrectly for local servers — it looks up the server name instead of the actual toolId returned by the discover phase. This completely blocks the use of local MCP servers, which are a core integration pattern. All local MCP servers with command array configuration are affected.
aliases: contextFn is not a function MCP
MCP tool execution broken for local servers
signals.review_reason: P0: Complete block of local MCP server usage — discover works but execute is completely broken. MCP is a primary extensibility mechanism; this makes all local MCP integrations unusable. Multiple users confirmed affected. No workaround besides abandoning the MCP integration entirely.

source_issues.title: MCP execute fails on local servers with 'contextFn is not a function'
source_issues.evidence: MCP discover succeeds (returns 180+ tools with toolId='js'), but execute fails with 'contextFn is not a function' and 'Tool ID nullplatform not found'. All local MCP servers with command array config are blocked. User marked as P0 — blocks core development workflow.

signals.topic: opencode run hangs in batch/TUI mode without --print-logs due to event bus backpressure stalling the prompt loop
signals.summary: When running opencode run in batch mode or piping output, the session hangs indefinitely. The root cause is that the event bus lacks sufficient consumers — without --print-logs, the log subscriber is not registered. The --print-logs flag registers a log consumer that accepts all event types, which drains the bus. Without it, synchronous publishing calls to the bus block when the bus fills, stalling the prompt loop. The hang manifests specifically during MCP calls or subagent invocations, where the output pipe fills and backpressures the event bus.
signals.review_reason: P0: Main execution path (batch mode, the primary headless usage) is completely broken. Users must add --print-logs as an undocumented workaround. CI/automation pipelines using opencode run are directly affected. Root cause is confirmed in event bus consumer registration.

source_issues.title: opencode hangs run in batch mode, but works with --print-logs
source_issues.evidence: Session hangs in batch mode (piping to tee) without --print-logs. Works fine with --print-logs flag. Root cause traced to event bus backpressure — the log subscriber drains the bus; without it, synchronous publishing blocks the prompt loop. Affects batch/CI usage.

signals.topic: opencode run resolves working directory from stale PWD instead of subprocess cwd, breaking programmatic/API launches
signals.summary: opencode run resolves its working directory from the caller's inherited PWD environment variable instead of the child process cwd set by subprocess.Popen(cwd=...). When Popen changes the child cwd, it does not rewrite PWD in the child environment. opencode run uses process.env.PWD ?? process.cwd(), so stale inherited PWD overrides the real child cwd. This breaks all programmatic callers (SDK users, Python/JavaScript wrappers, CI pipelines) that launch opencode run with a cwd override. The two cwd derivation paths (effectCmd directory callback and run handler root) can also disagree.
signals.review_reason: P0: Breaks the primary SDK/programmatic usage pattern — all users launching opencode run from Python/JS wrappers with cwd= get wrong directory. This is a regression from recent refactoring. Programmatic usage is a core use case for opencode.

source_issues.title: opencode run prefers stale PWD over subprocess cwd
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed regression from refactoring (commits 7409dcc6b, 2df8eda8a). Programmatic callers using subprocess.Popen(cwd=...) get wrong working directory. Workaround requires manually setting PWD=target_dir in env, which callers shouldn't need to do.

signals.topic: SSE parser concatenates data: lines with single newline, causing AI_JSONParseError on tool calls across multiple models and backends
signals.summary:
The SSE parser (eventsource-parser v3.0.8) only treats 

 as an event boundary. When backends send two data: lines separated by a single 
, the parser concatenates them into one event (e.g., {"role":"assistant"}{"id":"..."}), causing AI_JSONParseError on every tool call. This affects GLM-4.7, GLM-5.1, Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, Qwen3 across Baseten, z.ai, Copilot, and Nvidia NIM backends. Multiple historical issues (#5890, #8102, #10731, #23442, #24927) describe the same pattern. A vendor patch has been prepared.
signals.review_reason: P0: Every tool call fails with JSON parse error for users of 5+ models across 4+ backends. Complete loss of tool-use capability for affected model/backend combinations. Long-standing issue with known root cause in vendored dependency. The severity is systemic (not single-user edge case).

source_issues.title: [Bug] SSE stream boundary loss: data: lines concatenated without \\n\\n causes AI_JSONParseError across multiple models
source_issues.evidence: SSE parser concatenates data: lines on single \n. Every tool call fails with AI_JSONParseError on GLM-4.7, GLM-5.1, Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, Qwen3 across 4+ backends. 5 historical issues (years old) describe same pattern. PR submitted upstream.

signals.topic: Tool runner append_messages() causes infinite loop in advanced usage example
signals.summary: The 'Advanced usage' example in official tool runner docs calls `runner.append_messages()` inside the loop without also appending the tool result, which sets `_messages_modified=True` and blocks auto-append of the assistant message + tool result. This causes an infinite loop — the core workflow of the tool runner pattern is broken.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow is completely blocked — the tool runner loop never terminates when using the documented 'Advanced usage' pattern. This is a core API pattern that the official documentation teaches, and it enters an infinite loop. No user workaround without abandoning the documented approach.

source_issues.title: [Bug] append_messages() inside tool runner loop causes infinite loop (advanced usage docs example)
source_issues.evidence: Official docs example enters infinite loop: append_messages() sets _messages_modified=True, skipping auto-append of tool result. Next iteration sends request with no tool result in history, model re-makes tool call indefinitely. Core loop pattern is fundamentally broken.

signals.topic: Back-to-back prompt caching requests miss cache ~40% of the time, causing double billing
signals.summary: Two sequential client.messages.create() calls with identical cached system prompts result in ~40% cache miss rate on the second request. The same prefix is billed twice instead of being read from cache. A 2-second sleep between requests eliminates the issue, indicating a server-side cache visibility race condition. Each redundant write is billed at full cache_creation_input_tokens rate, causing direct cost loss.
aliases: prompt caching cache miss sequential requests
signals.review_reason: Clear, reproducible double-billing bug in a core cost-saving feature. ~40% of sequential identical requests are billed twice. The issue provides a 20-trial reproducer with deterministic results and a verified workaround (2s sleep). This is both a workflow failure and a direct financial loss for any user of the prompt caching feature.

source_issues.title: Cache misses on second back-to-back `client.messages.create()` (~40% rate)
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction shows 8/20 back-to-back identical requests miss the cache. Each miss bills the identical cache prefix twice at full cache_creation rate. Workaround (2s sleep) eliminates the issue, confirming a server-side race condition. Direct cost impact: every multi-turn workload without the sleep workaround overpays.

signals.topic: Managed Agents sessions.events.send lacks output_config/effort control — 3x cost and 3.3x latency vs messages.create
signals.summary: The messages.create API accepts output_config.effort to control thinking depth, but sessions.events.send (the only way to send user messages to managed agents) returns HTTP 400 with 'Extra inputs are not permitted'. Users cannot control effort on managed agents, resulting in platform-default high effort being applied at 3x the cost and 3.3x the latency of steered runs.
aliases: managed agents thinking effort cannot be set
signals.review_reason: Key feature parity gap: messages.create supports output_config.effort (GA), but managed agents have no equivalent. Users experience 3x cost and 3.3x latency overhead because the platform forces high-effort defaults they cannot override. This is a direct cost loss and workflow degradation for managed agents users.

source_issues.title: Managed Agents `sessions.events.send` rejects `output_config` with 400 — no parity with `messages.create` for effort/thinking control
source_issues.evidence: Reproducer with 400 response: extra_body={'output_config': {'effort': 'medium'}} rejected server-side. Verified no effort parameter anywhere on agents.create, agents.update, sessions.create, or sessions.events.send. Empirical evidence: default-effort runs cost $0.31 vs $0.10 for steered runs (3x) and 156s vs 47s active time (3.3x). Cost and latency impact is explicit and measurable.

signals.topic: Structured output + thinking + tool use produces invalid JSON and premature end_turn in multi-turn conversations
signals.summary: When using thinking (extended or adaptive), structured output (json_schema), and tools together in multi-turn conversations, the model either: (a) ends the turn with only a thinking block and empty text, no tool_use blocks, with stop_reason end_turn instead of tool_use; or (b) produces malformed JSON with partial content and 20+ blank lines in the final text block. The messages.parse SDK call fails to parse invalid responses, making production use unreliable.
signals.review_reason: Three core features (thinking, structured output, tool use) cannot be used together reliably in production. The combination either causes infinite loops (no tool_use blocks emitted) or produces unparseable JSON output. This blocks the intended use case of getting structured, reasoned, tool-using responses — a high-value workflow.

source_issues.title: Structured output + thinking + tool use: two bugs in multi-turn conversations
source_issues.evidence: Reproducer shows two distinct failure modes: (a) model returns thinking block + empty text with stop_reason end_turn instead of tool_use blocks — messages.parse fails; (b) final text block contains partial JSON + 20+ blank lines + valid JSON concatenated, making parsing impossible. Both failures make the core feature combination unusable in production.

signals.topic: SDK import time of ~209ms blocks fast startup for downstream frameworks (langchain_anthropic, etc.)

This cascades to downstream frameworks like langchain_anthropic which take 300ms+ for imports alone before making a single HTTP call.
signals.review_reason: 209ms import time for a thin HTTP client library is a significant developer experience regression. This directly impacts startup time for CLI tools, serverless functions, and frameworks like langchain_anthropic. The downstream cascade means any project importing the SDK pays this cost on every cold start or process boot.

source_issues.title: Slow imports
source_issues.evidence: python3 -X importtime shows 209ms total import time, with anthropic.types taking 116ms and anthropic.lib.tools taking 69ms. Downstream package langchain_anthropic affected. The issue author notes 'this is python's most central dependency' and 'a glorified HTTP client' shouldn't need 209ms to import.

signals.topic: toolRunner drops defaultHeaders on follow-up requests in tool-use loop, breaking proxy/gateway setups
signals.summary: toolRunner does not forward defaultHeaders on subsequent API calls during the tool-use loop, causing authentication failures when using proxies (e.g., Cloudflare AI Gateway with cf-aig-authorization header). The first call includes headers correctly, but follow-up calls drop them.
aliases: toolRunner missing defaultHeaders on follow-up requests
toolRunner drops auth headers during tool loop
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure: toolRunner is a core SDK feature. Dropping defaultHeaders on follow-up requests causes authentication failures that block the entire tool-use workflow. Cloudflare team confirmed this as an SDK bug. Affects any proxy/gateway that relies on custom auth headers, including Cloudflare AI Gateway's unified billing feature.

source_issues.title: `toolRunner` drops `defaultHeaders` on follow-up requests (breaks proxy/gateway setups)
source_issues.evidence: First API call includes defaultHeaders correctly; subsequent calls in the tool-use loop drop them, causing 'authentication_error: x-api-key header is required' from the API. Confirmed by Cloudflare team as SDK-side bug (cloudflare/ai#408). Breaks Cloudflare AI Gateway unified billing and BYOK setups, plus any custom proxy using header-based auth.

signals.topic: SDK strips directory paths from filenames in multipart uploads, blocking skills.versions.create()
signals.summary: The SDK's multipart form handling strips directory paths from filenames (e.g., 'my-skill/SKILL.md' becomes 'SKILL.md'), causing the API to reject skills.versions.create() which requires files to be in a top-level directory.
aliases: multipart upload strips directory from filename breaking skills API
skills.versions.create() fails due to SDK stripping file paths
signals.review_reason: Key workflow failure: skills.versions.create() is a core feature for updating skills, but the SDK silently corrupts filenames by stripping directory paths, causing API rejection. No workaround within SDK — users must delete and recreate skills instead of updating versions.

source_issues.title: SDK strips directory paths from filenames in multipart uploads, breaking skills.versions.create()
source_issues.evidence: SDK internally calls getName with stripPath=true, turning 'my-skill/SKILL.md' into 'SKILL.md'. API returns 400 'SKILL.md file must be exactly in the top-level folder.' skills.versions.create() is completely broken; users must delete and recreate the skill as a workaround. OpenAI Node SDK has the same issue (openai/openai-node#1807).

signals.topic: Streaming responses interrupted mid-transmission without message_stop event, losing data

aliases: streaming connection closes prematurely with large tool_use payloads
stream ends without message_stop event data loss
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure: streaming is terminated without proper termination events, causing data loss and parsing errors. Affects legitimate use cases requiring large JSON tool_use responses. The stream consumer speed affects delivery completeness, indicating a bug in SDK's streaming backpressure handling. Error is not recoverable without switching to non-streaming.

source_issues.title: Streaming responses consistently interrupted mid-transmission - connection closes without message_stop event

signals.topic: Vertex AI SDK returns wrong error path for document URL sources, making debugging difficult

signals.topic: zodOutputFormat helper fails when project uses zod v3 (zod3)

signals.topic: StructuredOutput tool intermittently wraps response in 'output' field, causing schema validation failures and agent confusion
signals.summary: The StructuredOutput tool non-deterministically wraps structured data in an extra `{"output": {...}}` field, causing JSON schema validation to fail. This leads to ResultMessage.structured_output being None and causes the agent to receive conflicting validation errors, sometimes degrading output quality (e.g., 47 items reduced to 1).
signals.review_reason: This is a genuine user-facing workflow runtime bug. The StructuredOutput tool is a core SDK feature used for structured data extraction, and its intermittent wrapping behavior causes non-deterministic validation failures, agent confusion, and degraded output quality. With 11 comments indicating sustained community interest, it clearly impacts real users in production scenarios. The intermittent nature makes it particularly insidious — it cannot be easily detected or worked around.

source_issues.title: [BUG] StructuredOutput tool wraps data in 'output' field causing schema validation to fail

signals.topic: Bundled CLI drops TRACEPARENT context propagation on 2nd+ query() call in long-running processes, breaking distributed tracing
signals.summary: When the bundled CLI is invoked multiple times in the same long-running Python process, the TRACEPARENT W3C trace context is silently ignored on the 2nd+ call. This fragments telemetry — every call after the first emits orphan root spans with fresh trace IDs instead of nesting under the caller's trace. The trigger is the persistent state at ~/.claude/ (specifically ~/.claude.json with firstStartTime marker).
aliases: TRACEPARENT dropped on second query call
telemetry tracing broken after first call
signals.review_reason: This is a direct user-impacting bug for anyone deploying the SDK in a long-running server or worker process — which is explicitly the dominant deployment shape per the hosting docs. After the first query() call, all subsequent calls produce fragmented orphan telemetry spans, making the observability/tracing flow described in the official docs unusable. The issue is fully reproducible (100%), has a known root cause (~/.claude/ state), and requires an expensive workaround (~20KB per call).

source_issues.title: Bundled CLI silently drops inbound TRACEPARENT on 2nd+ query() call when ~/.claude/ has state from a prior run
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible 100% of the time in a long-running Python process. call-1 spans nest correctly under TRACEPARENT; call-2+ produce orphan root spans with no parent trace_id. The root cause is ~~/.claude.json state (firstStartTime marker) that causes the CLI to skip OTel init on subsequent starts. Wiping ~/.claude/ between calls unblocks the bug. The workaround (unique HOME per call) has ~20KB cost per call.

signals.topic: SDK raises MessageParseError and crashes query when backend emits thinking block without required 'signature' field

signals.review_reason: This is a workflow-blocking crash that occurs in a legitimate use case: using the SDK with Anthropic-compatible third-party backends (which is a supported use case). The query crashes entirely after 30 seconds of work, wasting user time and blocking the main workflow. The issue has historical precedent (related issues #339, #473, #786) indicating it is a known pain point. Users are left without a viable workaround for non-Anthropic backends that emit thinking blocks.

source_issues.title: MessageParseError: missing signature in thinking block with claude-agent-sdk 0.1.79 and Anthropic-compatible backend
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible with latest SDK 0.1.79. Crash occurs after ~30 seconds of processing. Related issues #339 (closed not planned), #473, #786 show this is a recurring pattern. The SDK crashes the entire query when parsing an assistant message with a signature-less thinking block.

aliases: SDK docs missing public types and options

This directly impacts developer productivity and can lead users to incorrectly conclude features were removed. signals.topic: Cannot access resolved system prompt (merged CLAUDE.md content) from Python SDK layer for logging and debugging
signals.summary: Users building agents with CLAUDE.md have no visibility into the resolved system prompt that the CLI actually sends to the model. The Python SDK layer only exposes input prompts and output responses, leaving the effective system prompt (which includes CLAUDE.md, tone rules, formatting constraints) opaque. This makes it impossible to log or debug what the model actually received.
aliases: no access to resolved CLAUDE.md content
signals.review_reason: This is an enhancement request rather than a bug, but it describes a real developer experience gap. Users who rely on CLAUDE.md for agent behavior configuration have no way to introspect what the model actually receives, making debugging agent behavior extremely difficult. The issue is labeled 'enhancement' and 'question', but the underlying need (visibility into resolved system context) is legitimate and impacts anyone using CLAUDE.md in production.

source_issues.title: No way to access the resolved system prompt (from CLAUDE.md and similar files) via the Python SDK
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states they have no visibility into what the CLI loads internally — specifically the content from CLAUDE.md and other context files merged into the effective system prompt before the model is called. They can track input and output but not the resolved system prompt. This is critical for logging and debugging purposes.

signals.topic: Linux glibc 系统中 SDK 本地二进制解析器错误选择 musl 变体，导致 query() 启动失败
signals.summary: SDK 的本地二进制解析器在 Linux glibc 系统（如 GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest）上优先尝试 musl 变体而非 glibc 变体，当两个可选依赖均被安装时（pnpm 10 常见行为），require.resolve 成功解析 musl 路径但 spawn 执行时因缺少 /lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1 动态链接器而失败，抛出误导性错误 'Claude Code native binary not found'。影响约 30-50% 的首次安装场景，完全阻断 SDK 主流程。
aliases: Native binary ENOENT on glibc Linux
signals.review_reason: count=3 且三条独立报告均指向同一根因；完全阻断主流程 query()；在常见 CI 环境（ubuntu-latest + pnpm 10）中约 30-50% 触发率；用户必须手动指定 pathToClaudeCodeExecutable 才能绕过，影响大量 CI/CD 集成场景

source_issues.title: Native binary resolver picks linux-x64-musl on glibc systems, ignoring the libc field
source_issues.evidence: 完全阻断 query() 主流程；复现于 Ubuntu 24.04 + pnpm 10；提供了 root cause 代码位置和两种修复方案

source_issues.title: Binary picker selects musl variant on glibc Linux, causing ENOENT at spawn
source_issues.evidence: duplicate to #324；musl 包缺少 libc 字段导致 npm 无法正确过滤；同样导致 spawn ENOENT

source_issues.title: Linux: musl binary preferred over glibc in v0.2.116 CLI auto-discovery
source_issues.evidence: 独立报告（8条评论）；提供完整复现步骤、根因分析和 spawn probe 修复方案；明确影响主流程 query()

signals.topic: 使用 options.hooks 时 agent 忽略自定义 systemPrompt，身份识别变为 'Claude Code' 而非自定义 persona
signals.summary: 当向 query() 传入任意 hooks（PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PreCompact/SessionEnd）时，agent 完全忽略自定义 systemPrompt，在身份类查询（'who are you?'）中返回 'Claude Code' 而非自定义 persona。即使 hooks 处理器为空函数（async () => {}）也会触发该行为，证明问题与 hooks 内容无关，而是 hooks 选项的存在本身触发了身份漂移。生产多代理系统被迫在身份保真度和可观测性之间二选一。
aliases: custom persona ignored when hooks are used
signals.review_reason: 非 count>=3 但有强用户影响证据：生产环境 17-agent 企业系统在身份保真度和可观测性之间被迫二选一；8 小时调试成本；workaround 不完整（canUseTool 无法覆盖 PostToolUse/PreCompact/SessionEnd）；影响关键产品能力（多 agent 自定义 persona）

source_issues.title: options.hooks causes agent to ignore custom systemPrompt and identify as "Claude Code"

signals.topic: restore-config.ts cpSync crash when CLAUDE.md exists without .claude/ directory (ENOENT regression since v1.0.89)
signals.summary: When a PR head contains CLAUDE.md but lacks .claude/ directory, restoreConfigFromBase crashes with ENOENT because .claude-pr/ is not created before cpSync is called. This blocks the entire action on affected PRs. Regression introduced in v1.0.89; v1.0.88 is unaffected.
signals.review_reason: Two independent reports confirm a regression introduced in v1.0.89 causing cpSync to crash with ENOENT in restore-config.ts. Issue 1311: PRs with CLAUDE.md but no .claude/ dir crash immediately (main flow blocked). Issue 1187: symlinked SENSITIVE_PATHS also crash. Both have concrete error logs and a confirmed workaround (pin to v1.0.88). This is a primary flow blocker affecting all users on v1.0.89+ who open PRs with CLAUDE.md present.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase crashes with ENOENT when only CLAUDE.md exists (cpSync needs mkdir of .claude-pr/ first)
source_issues.evidence: Action crashes with ENOENT: no such file or directory, symlink. Regression since v1.0.89. Fix: add mkdirSync('.claude-pr', { recursive: true }) before the cpSync loop. Affects all PRs with CLAUDE.md but no .claude/ directory.

source_issues.title: cpSync crashes with ENOENT when sensitive paths are symlinks
source_issues.evidence: cpSync crashes with ENOENT when SENSITIVE_PATHS entries are symlinks. Root cause: cpSync defaults to dereference:false, tries to recreate symlink before parent dir exists. Introduced in #1174 / v1.0.89. Workaround: pin to v1.0.88.

signals.topic: claude-code-review.yml gh CLI invocations missing --repo flag, causing ~70% review-failure rate
signals.summary: The claude-code-review workflow calls gh pr view/list without --repo $GITHUB_REPOSITORY, causing 'no default remote repository' errors when the action runs in non-root working directories. Results in ~70% of PR reviews failing despite the action succeeding at all other steps.
aliases: gh CLI missing --repo flag in review workflow
gh pr view no default remote repository error
signals.review_reason: High-impact workflow failure: ~70% of PR reviews fail due to missing --repo flag on gh CLI calls. Affected user has provided concrete PR numbers (#62-74 on their repo) and a specific error message. While single-repo impact, the failure mode is clearly reproducible and deterministic, representing a systemic code path defect in the claude-code-review workflow.

source_issues.title: claude-code-review.yml has two recurring failure modes (Mode A: gh CLI invocation; Mode B: haiku dedup false-positive)
source_issues.evidence: Mode A: gh pr view called without --repo flag; errors 'no default remote repository or repository is not specified' when working dir is not repo root. Causes action to exit non-zero and skip posting review on ~70% of otherwise-passing PRs (PRs #62-74 on nedati-technologies/claude-wow-plugin in May 2026). Fix: always pass --repo '$GITHUB_REPOSITORY' to gh invocations.

signals.topic: Model sometimes posts raw CLAUDE.md verbatim as PR comment instead of structured review; action exits success (false-positive green check)
signals.summary: The action intermittently posts the repository's CLAUDE.md file verbatim as the PR review comment instead of the structured review the prompt template requests. The action exits success, so workflow checks are green, but no real review occurred. Naive setups that treat green check = review happened silently accept a non-review.
aliases: CLAUDE.md echoed as review comment instead of structured output
model confabulates CLAUDE.md content into review post
action exits success with wrong output shape
signals.review_reason: Intermittent but confirmed output-quality failure: the action posts raw CLAUDE.md (19k chars) instead of structured review while exiting success. This creates a false-positive green check that naive CI setups would accept as a passing review. The issue is reproducible via retry (workflow_dispatch works), with two consecutive runs on the same PR showing different outputs. Significant UX/trust impact even at count=1 because the symptom is a silent security bypass in review workflows.

source_issues.title: Action posts repo's CLAUDE.md verbatim as comment body instead of structured review (workflow exits success)
source_issues.evidence: Two consecutive runs on same PR: first produced 676-char structured review, second posted 19,407-char raw CLAUDE.md verbatim with no verdict tag. Action exited success on both runs. Naive CI setups that trust green check = review passed would silently accept a non-review. Retry via workflow_dispatch produces correct output. Hypothesis: model conflates context-loaded guidance file with content to post.

signals.topic: Agent halts after Edit/Write phase with end_turn and empty result; multi-step prompts never invoke Bash, task silently incomplete but action reports success
signals.summary: claude-sonnet-4-6 agent voluntarily halts with stop_reason: end_turn and empty result string after completing Edit/Write tool calls, never invoking Bash for verification steps, git ops, or gh pr create. Multi-step prompts fail to complete but the action returns outcome: success, silently masking the failure from orchestrating workflows.
aliases: end_turn halts after Edit/Write without Bash invocation
multi-step task incomplete but action reports success
agent stops early with empty result and pending todos
signals.review_reason: 7 reproducible failures over ~14 hours: the agent completes file edits but voluntarily halts before Bash verification steps, leaving multi-step tasks incomplete. Critically, the action returns outcome:success, so orchestrating workflows have no signal that the task failed. This is a silent failure mode where CI looks green but no work product was produced — a significant cost and trust issue. User has provided full reproducibility matrix and hypothesized root cause (claude-sonnet-4-6 behavioral change).

source_issues.title: Agent halts after Edit/Write phase with stop_reason: end_turn, never invokes Bash; multi-step prompts fail to complete (claude-sonnet-4-6)
source_issues.evidence: 7 reproducible runs over ~14 hours: agent reads files, creates TodoWrite items, makes Edit/Write calls, then halts with stop_reason:end_turn and empty result (0 Bash invocations vs 42 in working baseline). Pending TodoWrite items remain pending; no verification, git ops, or PR creation. Action returns outcome:success. The only invariant across all runs is claude-sonnet-4-6. Working baseline 16h prior used the same model successfully.

signals.topic: claude[bot] own commit triggers permanent red required check — claude-review workflow blocks itself via anti-loop guard
signals.summary: When claude[bot] pushes a commit addressing its own review feedback, the push triggers a pull_request event that re-runs claude-review, which then aborts with 'Workflow initiated by non-human actor: claude' error. The PR is left with a permanent failing required check that blocks merge, despite the failure being benign (the bot's own intentional commit).
aliases: claude-review blocks claude[bot] own commit and leaves permanent failing check
anti-loop guard causes false permanent required check failure
signals.review_reason: Benign scenario (bot addressing its own review feedback) causes permanent failing required check that blocks PR merge. The affected user has provided a concrete failing run URL and PR link. The anti-loop guard correctly identifies claude[bot] but fails to distinguish 'own intentional commit' from 'external bot push', resulting in a self-inflicted CI failure that requires manual override per affected PR.

source_issues.title: claude-review blocks itself when triggered by claude[bot]'s own commit — permanent red required check on PRs after @claude addresses review
source_issues.evidence: When claude[bot] pushes a fix commit, the push triggers pull_request event which re-runs claude-review. The action's anti-loop guard blocks claude[bot] and exits with 'non-human actor' error, leaving a permanent failing required check on the PR. Concrete example: PR #1596 on geniuskamo/ghana-realestate-platform. Workaround requires manual infrastructure-level override at merge time, breaking required-checks-must-be-green policy.

Preview pane URL truncation regression Windows

signals.topic: Bash tool `claude sessions list` triggers recursive fork bomb with shell alias expansion, consuming entire usage quota and halting system
signals.summary: When Claude runs `claude sessions list` via the Bash tool and the user has `claude` aliased to `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`, the alias triggers recursive spawning of ~197 concurrent Claude Code processes. This drove system load to 149.86, consumed the entire Claude Max usage quota within minutes, left 940 total processes, and halted all other running Claude Code instances. The multiplication happened entirely downstream of a single Bash call.
signals.review_reason: Main flow completely blocked (session history search triggers fork bomb), massive cost loss (entire Max quota consumed within minutes), system-wide CPU/resource exhaustion making the machine barely responsive. Despite count=1 in this dataset, the issue is marked duplicate with has repro, and the user impact is catastrophic — direct monetary loss plus complete workflow halt. P0 is warranted due to severity and scope of impact.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Running `claude sessions list` via Bash tool triggers recursive process fork bomb, consuming entire usage quota
source_issues.evidence: Recursive fork bomb from single `claude sessions list` Bash call spawning ~197 concurrent `--dangerously-skip-permissions` processes. Load 149.86, 940 processes, 0% CPU idle, entire Claude Max quota consumed within minutes, all other Claude instances halted. 37 orphaned /tmp/claude-*-cwd temp files confirmed. Marked duplicate indicating multiple affected users.

signals.topic: MCP stdio server `tools/call` requests never written to stdin — UI spinner hangs indefinitely, regression from 2026-05-12 build
signals.summary: After connecting any local stdio MCP server (verified with cupertino and iterm-mcp), the MCP lifecycle up to `tools/list` succeeds, but `tools/call` is never written to the server's stdin. The UI spinner hangs forever with frozen token counter. The root cause traces to a new `disclaimer` helper introduced in the 2026-05-12 build that wraps the server spawn process. No `tools/call` entry ever appears in MCP server logs.
aliases: MCP tools/call never sent to stdin
stdio MCP tools blocked by disclaimer helper
signals.review_reason: Core MCP functionality completely broken for ALL stdio MCP servers — `tools/call` is never sent to stdin, UI hangs indefinitely with no error surfaced. The regression is confirmed by the user (worked before 2026-05-12 build) and linked to a specific new process-spawn helper. Despite the `invalid` label from maintainers, the technical evidence is exceptionally detailed (root cause traced to `disclaimer` helper via `strings` analysis), reproduced across two unrelated servers, and corroborated by 4 linked issues with identical symptoms. The `invalid` label likely reflects a classification disagreement rather than absence of user impact. P0 warranted: critical feature (MCP stdio) fully blocked, no workaround, affects all stdio MCP server users.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Claude Desktop 2.1.126 (2026-05-12): tools/call never written to MCP server stdin — UI spinner hangs forever, log shows no tools/call entry
source_issues.evidence: Detailed technical root cause analysis: new `disclaimer` helper (spawned as `/Applications/Claude.app/Contents/Helpers/disclaimer /path/to/server serve`) introduced in 2026-05-12 build breaks JSON-RPC stdin write for tools/call. Verified with two unrelated MCP servers (cupertino Swift binary, iterm-mcp Node.js). No `tools/call` line ever appears in mcp-server log. Same symptom referenced in #37806 (March 2026), #58771 (2026-05-12 regression), #22299 (v2.1.22 Windows), #50319. Regression confirmed by user — worked before 2026-05-12 build.

signals.topic: Session resume fails with API 500 (no body) for all non-trivial sessions due to empty thinking and empty tool_result content blocks persisted to JSONL
signals.summary: Old sessions of any non-trivial size fail to resume with `API Error: 500 status code (no body)`. Root cause: Claude Code persists empty-string thinking content blocks (with valid-looking signatures) and empty-content tool_result blocks (from deferred tools like ToolSearch for deleted environments). When the API replays these on resume, it rejects them with a 500. The session transcript becomes permanently unresumable.
aliases: empty tool_result content blocks prevent session continuation
signals.review_reason: Session resume — a core, primary workflow feature — is completely broken for ALL non-trivial sessions. The 500 error is caused by Claude Code itself persisting invalid content blocks to JSONL that the Anthropic API rejects on replay. This is a data-integrity + core-feature issue. `has repro` label and extremely detailed line-by-line transcript evidence confirm the root cause. P0 warranted: critical primary feature permanently broken for all sessions above a size threshold.

source_issues.title: Resuming old sessions returns API Error: 500 status code (no body) — caused by empty thinking and tool_result blocks persisted to JSONL
source_issues.evidence: User investigated three failing sessions (346, 147, 161 empty thinking blocks respectively) by reading the on-disk .jsonl transcripts. Evidence from session log: empty thinking block with 464-char signature followed by tool_use with parentUuid pointing to it, then tool_result with content_len=0, then 500 error. Confirmed regression — worked in 2.1.50, broken in current. Very detailed technical analysis with line-by-line evidence from the transcript file. `has repro` label assigned by maintainers.

signals.topic: Auto-mode permission classifier trust decay and hard-rail misattribution make autonomous sessions progressively unusable on Windows
signals.summary: Two compounding defects in the auto-mode permission classifier: (1) accumulated denial count causes unrelated subsequent commands in the same trust class to be denied even when they previously succeeded in the same session; (2) classifier records its own hard-blocks as user rejections in session state, then uses that false attribution to deny subsequent unrelated commands. Commands like `pnpm --version` denied after `pnpm install` already succeeded; build scripts denied because a prior settings.json hard-rail was misattributed to the user.
aliases: auto mode progressively denies unrelated commands
signals.review_reason: Auto-mode autonomous execution is progressively degraded by the classifier's trust model: unrelated commands denied after accumulated denials, hard-rails misattributed as user rejections and used to poison subsequent permissions. Makes multi-hour autonomous sessions increasingly unusable — a key use case for Claude Code. Linked to 4 other issues on the same architectural problem. P1: not a complete block but significantly undermines the core value proposition of unattended autonomous development.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Auto-mode classifier: session-level trust decay + hard-rail misattributed as user rejection (Windows, v2.1.138)
source_issues.evidence: Two specific defects documented with exact command sequences: `pnpm install` allowed → `pnpm --version` denied (same tool, same trust class, later in same session); `node scripts/build-core.js` denied in same directory where `pnpm install` succeeded; explicit user authorization overridden and attributed to user as 'rejection' in classifier's session state. Linked to #54784, #51676, #50331, #53610 as related root-cause issues. `has repro` label. Regression confirmed.
